flags.why: This pronoun is characteristic of Central Vietnamese, especially Nghệ–Tĩnh, but lacks a regional tag ([Vinh University](https://khoaspnv.vinhuni.edu.vn/nghien-cuu-khoa-hoc/ly-luan-ngon-ngu/seo/ve-dep-cua-vi-giam-nghe-tinh-tu-goc-nhin-ngon-ngu-67108)).
The teapot or kettle meaning is specifically associated with Hải Phòng and needs a Northern warning ([Wiktionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/cho%C3%A9)).
flags.fix: Tags: rare, Northern; gloss: teapot; kettle (Hải Phòng dialect).
